table.role: Implementation language for the API, browse tiers, history and tools.
HTTP API framework serving api/main.py routes on 127.0.0.1:8506.
ASGI server running the FastAPI app.
Outbound client for thumbnails and stream proxying.
Tier-1 browse: extracts real stream URLs / metadata from tube sites for playback and downloads.
TLS/browser-impersonation backend required by yt-dlp for Dailymotion and other guarded sites.
Tier-3 headless-render fallback for JS-only video-grid sites (browse.py); browsers staged to runtime/browsers for portable builds.
web/vendor/hls.min.js plays proxied HLS (.m3u8) streams in the browser.
Video join / re-encode / stream copy; staged into runtime/ffmpeg for portable builds.
Runs PlayDeck as a Windows service per QI convention.

descriptions.title: Stack
descriptions.body: Own video-player UI at C:\PlayDeck (:8506). Three-tier browse: yt-dlp extraction, HTML scrape, Playwright headless render. Offline library + play history in SQLite. Known gotchas: JS-rendered homepages, blank.gif thumbnails, unknown-codec formats, logging-toggle needs a sole file handler.
